answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real capital and burn compute per identity, making mass duplication expensive. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then maintain a public reputation ledger. Think of a lagoon island where each new settler needs a scarce pigment dye to mark their claim; forging thousands of claims drains the attacker's dye supply fast, so honest agents dominate. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
